name: Stay
detailed_description:
The moon has exploded! What will happen to humanity? You can't do much to save the world, but you can at least try to save yourself, and the people that pass by your home in search of shelter.

Interrogate

the people who knock at your door. Choose wisely who you let in. Try to assemble the best possible team to deal with what's out there. Not everyone is equally valid, so think carefully about what to do. In Stay, you should trust nobody.

Manage

your limited resources well. In a post-apocalyptic world, food and tools are scarce. Keep a close eye on your resources, and use them at the right times, or you will find yourself without them when you need them the most. There is just a few resources in Stay world.

Research

your teammates. Each character is different, with their own stories, likes and dislikes. Try to gain their trust to find out what their strengths and weaknesses are. You might be surprised what a book can hide behind its cover. Nobody is like they seems to be in Stay.

Decide

how to deal with each situation. You don't know what each day will bring, but surely nothing good. In such a hostile world, it's important to always make the right decisions. One little slip-up and it could be the end of your team. Each decision matters in Stay.

Survive

as long as you can with your teammates. You may not be able to save the world, but you may be able to save your team. It won't be easy, and you will probably lose members along the way, but there will always be hope that tomorrow will be better. The world of Stay will not make it easy for you.

short_description: Stay is a narrative roguelike where you will have to survive a post-apocalyptic world from your cabin. Choose well who you let into your home, manage the available resources, and look for the best strategy to go ahead at the end of the world. Survive with your team, or die along the way.
